section_summary: This section contains State Department despatches, memoranda, operational reports, and legislative summaries from December 1946 to March 1948 concerning the Japanese National Diet under the new Constitution. It documents Far Eastern Commission discussions on reviewing implementing legislation, evaluates the political roles and committee performance of female Diet members, and reports on the development of standing committees and Diet-Cabinet relations. Later documents record the creation of the Special Committee on Irregular Property Transactions, a comprehensive list of First Diet legislation, and the establishment and statutory framework of the National Diet Library.

subfiles.about: Discusses Far Eastern Commission jurisdiction and procedures for reviewing Japanese Diet legislation implementing the new Constitution.
subfiles.summary: Reports discussions on procedures for Far Eastern Commission review of Diet implementing legislation and consultation with SCAP.
subfiles.title: FEC Consideration of Implementing Legislation
subfiles.to: John Carter Vincent (FE) and Hugh Borton (JA)

subfiles.about: Form designating a replacement record copy for Despatch No. 1042 from Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Document file form designating a replacement record copy for Despatch 1042 from Tokyo for Central Records filing.
subfiles.title: Record Copy Replacement Form for Despatch No. 1042

subfiles.about: Transmits a SCAP Government Section memorandum concerning the activity of women members in the 90th and 91st Diet sessions.
subfiles.from: United States Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Cover despatch transmitting a SCAP Government Section memorandum and questionnaire regarding women members of the Japanese Diet.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1042: Activity of Women Members of the 90th and 91st Sessions of the Japanese Diet

subfiles.about: Analyzes the background, committee work, interpellations, press reaction, and survey answers of women members of the Diet.
subfiles.from: Political Affairs Division, Government Section, GHQ SCAP
subfiles.summary: Detailed study analyzing the performance, party affiliations, committee assignments, and public reception of female Diet members during the 90th and 91st sessions. It examines debates on repatriation and livelihood protection, profiles Shizue Kato and Toshiko Karasawa, and tabulates survey responses on legislative effectiveness.
subfiles.title: Memorandum: Women Members of the 90th and 91st Sessions of the Diet

subfiles.about: Operations report covering the appointment of Senzo Higai to the Joint Legislative Committee, postal expansions, and hospital statistics.
subfiles.summary: Operations report noting Senzo Higai as chairman of the Joint Legislative Committee, expanded international mail, and national hospital statistics.
subfiles.title: Incoming Telegram No. W-87958 / MC IN 67954

subfiles.about: Transmits SCAP Government Section report No. 65(1) on the third month of the First National Diet.
subfiles.from: Counselor of Mission, United States Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Transmittal despatch forwarding a report prepared by Dr. Justin Williams on the third month of the First National Diet.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1270: Report Concerning the Third Month of the First Session of the Japanese National Diet

subfiles.about: Evaluates the operations, standing committees, Cabinet relations, and public hearings of the First National Diet during August 1947.
subfiles.from: Dr. Justin Williams, Government Section, GHQ SCAP
subfiles.summary: Analyzes the development of the National Diet during August 1947 under the new Constitution. Focuses on the growing assertiveness of standing committees, resistance to Cabinet rule by order, the first public hearings on the Civil and Criminal Codes, and debates on economic issues.
subfiles.title: The National Diet, Report No. 65(1): Third Month of the National Diet: August, 1947

subfiles.about: Transmits an extract from SCAP report regarding the creation of the Special Committee on Irregular Property Transactions.
subfiles.from: Acting Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Transmittal despatch enclosing a SCAP report extract regarding the Diet resolution creating a committee to investigate irregular property transactions.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1468: Establishment of a Special House of Representatives Committee on Irregular Property Transactions

subfiles.about: Reports emergency financial measures enacted, validity of Kodan laws, and the resolution creating the Special Committee on Irregular Property Transactions.
subfiles.from: Legislative Division, Government Section, GHQ SCAP
subfiles.summary: SCAP Government Section report detailing four enacted financial laws, upholding Kodan legislation, and the full resolution text creating the Special Committee on Irregular Property Transactions.
subfiles.title: Extract from The National Diet, No. 2 (2): 4 Bills Enacted, Kodan Laws, and Hoarded Commodities Committee

subfiles.about: Transmits a comprehensive SCAP report summarizing all legislation introduced in the First National Diet.
subfiles.from: Acting Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Transmittal despatch enclosing a comprehensive summary of all legislation introduced and passed during the First National Diet.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1488: Transmittal of a Report Concerning Legislation of the First National Diet

subfiles.about: Standard Department of State document charge-out slip Form DS-933 inserted into the file.
subfiles.summary: Blank Department of State document charge-out slip Form DS-933 used for tracking borrowed or removed files.
subfiles.title: Form DS-933 Charge-Out Record

subfiles.about: Tabular summary of all bills and budgets introduced into the First National Diet from May 20 to December 9, 1947.
subfiles.from: Capt. R. G. Brown, Legislative Division, GHQ SCAP
subfiles.summary: Comprehensive tabular summary compiled by Captain R. G. Brown listing all 186 bills and budgets introduced into the First National Diet by Cabinet boards, ministries, and Diet houses. It details dates of introduction and passage in both chambers and provides a final statistical breakdown showing 174 enacted and 12 unpassed.
subfiles.title: Legislative Summary - 1st National Diet (20 May 1947 - 9 December 1947)

subfiles.about: Reports the enactment of the National Diet Library Law and Building Commission Law, detailing American expert assistance and organizational structure.
subfiles.from: W. J. Sebald, Acting United States Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Despatch reporting the enactment of the National Diet Library Law and the Building Commission Law, drafted with advice from American consultants Charles H. Brown and Verner W. Clapp. Discusses committee leadership, staffing, branch libraries including Ueno Library, and interim housing.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 141: Creation of Japanese National Diet Library

subfiles.about: English translation of the National Diet Library Law setting out library purposes, administration, reference services, and branches.
subfiles.summary: Unofficial English translation of the 31 articles of the National Diet Library Law promulgated on February 9, 1948. It defines the organization, functions of the Chief Librarian, Legislative Reference Department, integration of government branch libraries, public access, and legal deposit requirements.
subfiles.title: Enclosure No. 1 to Despatch No. 141: National Diet Library Law (Law No. 5 of 1948)

subfiles.about: English translation of the law creating a commission to plan, site, and budget the National Diet Library building.
subfiles.summary: Translation of the four-article law establishing the National Diet Library Building Commission to prepare specifications, select an architect and site, and oversee construction.
subfiles.title: Enclosure No. 2 to Despatch No. 141: National Diet Library Building Commission Law
